title: SolarWinds publishes fixes for critical Serv-U privilege escalation flaws, including CVE-2026-123172
date_note: The SolarWinds advisories give 11/24/2026 as the first-published day; no earlier day is given.
summary: SolarWinds published advisories for several Serv-U flaws rated critical (CVSS 9.1), including CVE-2026-123172, a privilege escalation that could give root on Linux installations; the advisory says Windows installations face lower risk. Other advisories describe path traversal, insufficient validation and time-of-check to time-of-use flaws. The advisories name affected Serv-U versions and a fixed release. The pages read do not mention exploitation.
plain: SolarWinds says several serious flaws in its Serv-U file transfer software are fixed in a new release. The advisories read do not mention attacks.
exec: SolarWinds rates these Serv-U flaws critical (CVSS 9.1) and names a fixed release.
action: SolarWinds' advisories name the fixed Serv-U release; update to it.

validation.note: Vendor's own advisories (SolarWinds), five read. Other Serv-U CVEs in the same batch (CVE-2026-82319 to 82322) were not read and are not listed.
